instruction: Please help me change VS Code's user interface language to "Portuguese" without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible in the OSWorld environment. VS Code's localization system is built on language pack extensions. Without the ability to install the Portuguese Language Pack extension, changing the interface language is not achievable.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - VS Code's UI language localization requires language pack extensions
Instruction explicitly prohibits using extensions ('without using any extensions'), making the task impossible to complete
No alternative method exists to change VS Code's interface language to Portuguese without the Portuguese Language Pack extension
The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically appropriate for this task that cannot be completed as specified
